items.name: Concepción al Cubo V2 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBangwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--971a823d9d5dd23d1cd51053980e83ce5b04bdd4/logo%20ccp2024.png) Español Este 25 y 26 de mayo en la ciudad de Concepción, los speedcubers se reunirán para competir en una serie de desafíos de velocidad y habilidad. Únete a nosotros para un torneo de dos días lleno de giros, vueltas y momentos emocionantes mientras celebramos nuestra pasión por el cubo Rubik. ¡Prepárense para desafiar sus mentes, superar sus límites y descubrir quién será coronado como el campeón de Concepción al Cubo 2! ¡Nos vemos en la competencia! English This May 25 and 26 in the city of Concepción, speedcubers will meet to compete in a series of speed and skill challenges. Join us for a two-day tournament full of twists, turns, and exciting moments as we celebrate our passion for the Rubik's Cube. Get ready to challenge your minds, push your limits, and find out who will be crowned the champion of Concepción al Cubo 2! See you at the competition!

items.name: mcubes Cubing Clash 2024
items.information: **Important Information for Participants**: **Location**: The competition will take place on the 5th floor of the Centre Square Mall. **Arrival Time**: Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering**: All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants**: If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement**: First-time participants are required to bring a scanned copy of their ID card. Please ensure you have this with you. **Cube Requirement**: Participants must bring their own cubes. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants**: If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit both a physical and photo copy of your ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
